summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K to disclose a Material Fact under Chilean securities law. The bank issued a CHF 100 million bond under its EMTN Programme, maturing August 26, 2031, at a yield of 1.2575%, with settlement August 26, 2026. This is a routine debt issuance by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No equity, M&A, or restructuring elements are present. The filing serves as a regulatory disclosure of standard financing activity. What to watch: none from a special-situations perspective, as this is ordinary course liability management.
